title: 社会調査法
subtitle: Social Research Methods
keywords: Social Survey 2.Quantitative and Qualitative Research 3.Population and Sample 4.Design of Social Surveys 5.Data Tabulation and Analysis
educationalGoal: This course corresponds to the learning and educational objective of the Department of Environmental Design and Creation Studies, which is “the basic ability to collaborate through communication. This course is designed to deepen students' understanding of “social research,” one of the methods used to gain a better and more accurate understanding of the people we live with from the wealth of information that is available in the world today.
advice: This class is designed to deepen students' understanding of people living together and the environment in which we live. Students are encouraged to read the assigned chapters in the textbook in advance, and to actively voice their questions and discuss them in class.
